title: RayCast
subtitle: Your media, organised. On any screen.
summary: A complete media hub: organise your library, build subtitles, and cast to a TV, another browser, or any screen, with your phone as the remote.
description: RayCast started as a way to get media onto the big screen and grew into a full media hub. It organises your local library into shows and movies, builds subtitles and fixes their timing, and casts to a Chromecast, a browser tab, or your whole screen. It can also turn any other browser into a cast screen, and a phone companion app puts the controls in your hand. It all runs on your computer, so your media stays local.
features: A full media library
Shows and movies, organised with thumbnails, search, sorting, and recently watched.
Cast anywhere
Send to a Chromecast, cast a browser tab, or share your whole screen.
Any browser, a new screen
Generate an external screen and cast to another browser, on any device.
Subtitles, built in
Build subtitles, load them independently, and fix out-of-sync timing locally, with a preview before saving.
Your phone, the remote
A companion app to browse your library and control playback from your phone.
Local and personal
Runs on your computer, so your media stays local. Pick from five themes.

title: Edgewise
subtitle: Where the markets disagree.
summary: An on-demand research tool that lines up prediction-market odds across exchanges and shows where they don’t agree.
description: The same question can carry different odds on different prediction markets. Edgewise puts those prices side by side, highlights meaningful gaps, and explains every signal it raises. It only runs when you ask, keeps its data on your own machine, and never places a trade. It’s a research tool, not a trading bot.
features: Odds, side by side
One row per prediction, with each exchange’s price next to the others.
Signals that explain themselves
Every flag shows its prices, volume, and exactly why it qualified.
Only when you ask
No background scanning. Every query is bounded, cancellable, and timestamped.
Test it on paper
A virtual portfolio follows signals without real money or real orders.

title: World Cup 2026
subtitle: The whole tournament. In one place.
summary: An automated tournament tracker, from the first kickoff to the final whistle.
description: A complete view of the World Cup: automatically updated scores, group standings, a knockout bracket, and detailed match views. Follow the action on screen or export a printable wall chart.
features: 104 matches
Automated score tracking across the tournament.
One complete view
Group standings and a bracket that advances as results arrive.
Every match, closer
Event timelines, statistics, momentum, and lineups.
On screen. On paper.
Responsive views and printable A3 charts.
